name: Yuuna
source:
Role: Idol

Yuuna is a local idol who recently gained popularity. She has all the exceptional talent for entertainment. Needless to say, her future in the industry is bright. Since she is still a child, majority of her fans are lolicons. For them she is not just an ordinary idol but an Ai-doll.

[spoiler]Her true identity is [url=/c1481]Yuubana Mayuki[/url].[/spoiler]
